title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young female warrior with white and lavender hair in buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional outfit with intricate patterns, wields crackling purple energy magic in both hands, and has glowing arcane symbols floating around her head.
prompt: A young East Asian female warrior with long white hair tied in two buns with purple ribbons, wearing a detailed white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with a sash and patterned trim, standing in a powerful combat stance. She summons glowing purple magical energy that swirls around her hands and forms chains and crescents. Purple arcane runes and crackling energy float above her head. Sharp, clean digital illustration style with strong lighting and solid gray background.
